ff162-164.summary: The credence: the rest 'consists in the credence of the bearer and the said articles'.
ff162-164.en: [?] consists in the credence of the [?] bearer and the said articles.

system: Letter cipher of invented signs and digits with homophones, digraph and word signs (de, la, le, que, sur, nous, et; ss, mm, ll, nn, ee) and nulls, some look-alike labels still carrying two values (Tomokiyo's table, corrected by Brackx).
